On this page

Spatial and space-time fields ​

Share information between nearby observations, neighboring areas or related measurement channels. Choose a representation from the observation geometry and the predictions you need.

DataTermRepresentation
Areas with known neighborscar(area; edges=(from,to), type=:bym2)Graph field plus independent area effects
Smooth continuous coordinateshsgp(east,north; k=(kx,ky))Fixed Hilbert basis with kx*ky weights
Points evolving over timegmrf((east,north),time; mesh=...)Triangular-mesh Matérn field with OU evolution
Sparse irregular position–time readsgmrf((east,north),time; neighbors=m)Local Gaussian conditionals on the observed states
Irregular reads needing exact OU time covariancegmrf((east,north),time; multiresolution=m)Sparse spatial basis of shared OU paths

Use a common planar distance unit. Longitude and latitude in degrees need a suitable projection before they represent distances in these terms.

Areal effects ​

ICAR shares information through adjacency. BYM2 adds independent area effects and estimates the structured variance share. The intercept carries the overall level; an exposure offset keeps the field on a relative-risk scale.

"""
Each value's position among the sorted levels `sorted_levels`, by binary search (`car` node labels).
"""
ReactiveKernels.@kernel(brm_sorted_positions(values, sorted_levels) = begin
            positions = ReactiveKernels.plate(values) do value
                    BayesianRegressionModels._brm_sorted_position(sorted_levels, value)
                end
            return positions
        end)

"""
An areal (`car`) effect in the BYM2 convolution.

Draws the scale `sigma`, the mixing weight `rho`, unstructured effects `theta ~ Normal(0, 1)`
and the ICAR field `phi ~ ICAR(node1, node2)` over the areas' adjacency, with a soft sum-to-zero per connected component. Islands read 0. Returns each row's area effect,
`sigma .* (sqrt.(rho .* inv_scale) .* phi_full .+ sqrt.(1 .- rho .* is_struct) .* theta)` at the row's area `area`.
"""
brm_car_bym2(node1, node2, struct_pos, area, comp_start, comp_size, inv_scale, is_struct) = begin
        sigma ~ restricted(Normal(0.0, 0.5), 0.0, Inf)
        rho ~ Beta(2.0, 2.0)
        theta[axes(inv_scale, 1)] .~ Normal.(0, 1)
        S = sum(comp_size)
        phi[1:S] ~ ICAR(node1, node2)
        cs = cumsum(vcat(0.0, phi))
        phi_sums = cs[comp_start .+ comp_size] .- cs[comp_start]
        phi_sums .~ Normal.(0.0, 0.001 .* comp_size)
        phi_full = (vcat(phi, 0.0))[struct_pos]
        effects = sigma .* (sqrt.(rho .* inv_scale) .* phi_full .+ sqrt.(1.0 .- rho .* is_struct) .* theta)
        return effects[area]
    end

begin
    car_rate_area_area = brm_sorted_positions(area, car_rate_area_nodes)
    car_rate_area ~ brm_car_bym2(car_rate_area_node1, car_rate_area_node2, car_rate_area_struct_pos, car_rate_area_area, car_rate_area_comp_start, car_rate_area_comp_size, car_rate_area_inv_scale, car_rate_area_is_struct)
    rate_Intercept ~ Normal(0.0, 1.0)
    log_rate = .+(rate_Intercept, log_expected, car_rate_area)
    rate = exp.(log_rate)
    cases .~ PoissonLog.(log_rate)
end

functions {
matrix hcat(vector x) {
    int n = dims(x)[1];
    return to_matrix(x, n, 1);
}
real brm_icar_lpdf(
    vector phi,
    array[] int node1,
    array[] int node2,
    array[] int comp_start,
    array[] int comp_size
) {
    int E = dims(node1)[1];
    int C = dims(comp_start)[1];
    if (dims(node2)[1] != E) reject("brm_icar_lpdf: dim mismatch — `node2` dim 1 (= ", dims(node2)[1], ") does not match `E` (= ", E, "), inferred from `node1` dim 1. `E` sizes: `node1` dim 1 (= ", dims(node1)[1], "), `node2` dim 1 (= ", dims(node2)[1], ").");
    if (dims(comp_size)[1] != C) reject("brm_icar_lpdf: dim mismatch — `comp_size` dim 1 (= ", dims(comp_size)[1], ") does not match `C` (= ", C, "), inferred from `comp_start` dim 1. `C` sizes: `comp_start` dim 1 (= ", dims(comp_start)[1], "), `comp_size` dim 1 (= ", dims(comp_size)[1], ").");
    real lp = (-0.5 * dot_self((phi[node1] - phi[node2])));
    for(c in 1:C) {
        lp += normal_lpdf(sum(segment(phi, comp_start[c], comp_size[c])) | 0.0, (0.001 * comp_size[c]));
    }
    return lp;
}
vector car_bym2_effects(
    real sigma,
    real rho,
    vector phi,
    vector theta,
    array[] int struct_idx,
    vector inv_scale
) {
    int N = dims(theta)[1];
    if (dims(struct_idx)[1] != N) reject("car_bym2_effects: dim mismatch — `struct_idx` dim 1 (= ", dims(struct_idx)[1], ") does not match `N` (= ", N, "), inferred from `theta` dim 1. `N` sizes: `theta` dim 1 (= ", dims(theta)[1], "), `struct_idx` dim 1 (= ", dims(struct_idx)[1], "), `inv_scale` dim 1 (= ", dims(inv_scale)[1], ").");
    if (dims(inv_scale)[1] != N) reject("car_bym2_effects: dim mismatch — `inv_scale` dim 1 (= ", dims(inv_scale)[1], ") does not match `N` (= ", N, "), inferred from `theta` dim 1. `N` sizes: `theta` dim 1 (= ", dims(theta)[1], "), `struct_idx` dim 1 (= ", dims(struct_idx)[1], "), `inv_scale` dim 1 (= ", dims(inv_scale)[1], ").");
    vector[N] out;
    for(k in 1:N) {
        out[k] = (sqrt((1.0 - (rho * (struct_idx[k] > 0)))) * theta[k]);
        if((struct_idx[k] > 0)) {
            out[k] += (sqrt((rho * inv_scale[k])) * phi[struct_idx[k]]);
        }
    }
    return (sigma * out);
}
vector car_rows(
    vector effects,
    array[] int row_idx
) {
    int R = dims(row_idx)[1];
    return effects[row_idx];
}
vector poisson_lpmfs(
    array[] int obs,
    vector lambda
) {
    return jbroadcasted_poisson_lpmfs(obs, lambda);
}
vector jbroadcasted_poisson_lpmfs(
    array[] int x1,
    vector x2
) {
    int n = dims(x1)[1];
    vector[n] rv;
    for(i in 1:n) {
        rv[i] = poisson_lpmfs(broadcasted_getindex(x1, i), broadcasted_getindex(x2, i));
    }
    return rv;
}
real poisson_lpmfs(int args1, real args2) {
    return poisson_lpmf(args1 | args2);
}
int broadcasted_getindex(array[] int x, int i) {
    return x[i];
}
real broadcasted_getindex(vector x, int i) {
    return x[i];
}
array[] int poisson_int_rng(
    int anontok__1,
    vector p
) {
    int n = anontok__1;
    return poisson_rng(p);
}
}

Data: area, car_rate_area_comp_size, car_rate_area_comp_start, car_rate_area_inv_scale, car_rate_area_is_struct, car_rate_area_node1, car_rate_area_node2, car_rate_area_nodes, car_rate_area_struct_pos, cases, log_expected.

- `car_rate_area`: An areal (`car`) effect in the BYM2 convolution.

class StaticInt(int):
    """An integer of the prepared data that sets a shape.

    It is an `int` everywhere, and `jax.jit` treats it as static, so the
    functions jit with the prepared data as arguments; a new value traces
    them again.
    """

    def __repr__(self):
        return "StaticInt(%d)" % int(self)


jax.tree_util.register_pytree_node(StaticInt, lambda s: ((), int(s)), lambda v, _: StaticInt(v))


def _rk_log1mlogistic(x):
    # log(1 - logistic(x)) (LogExpFunctions.log1mlogistic).
    return jax.nn.log_sigmoid(-x)


def _rk_lgamma_correction(x):
    # log(gamma(x)) - ((x - 0.5) * log(x) - x + 0.5 * log(2 pi)), for x >= 10:
    # the Stirling series through x^-15.
    z = 1.0 / (x * x)
    return (1.0 / x) * (1.0 / 12 + z * (-1.0 / 360 + z * (1.0 / 1260 + z * (-1.0 / 1680
        + z * (1.0 / 1188 + z * (-691.0 / 360360 + z * (1.0 / 156 + z * (-3617.0 / 122400))))))))


def _rk_logbeta_np(a, b):
    # SpecialFunctions.logbeta for positive arguments. With b the larger, a
    # large b subtracts log(gamma(b)) - log(gamma(a + b)) in Stirling form,
    # without cancellation.
    a, b = np.minimum(a, b), np.maximum(a, b)
    small = ssp.gammaln(a) + ssp.gammaln(b) - ssp.gammaln(a + b)
    big = np.maximum(b, 10.0)
    large = (ssp.gammaln(a) + _rk_lgamma_correction(big) - _rk_lgamma_correction(a + big)
             - (a + big - 0.5) * np.log1p(a / big) - a * np.log(big) + a)
    return np.where(b < 10, small, large)


def prepare_data(area: Any, car_rate_area_area: ArrayLike, car_rate_area_comp_size: ArrayLike, car_rate_area_comp_start: ArrayLike, car_rate_area_inv_scale: ArrayLike, car_rate_area_is_struct: ArrayLike, car_rate_area_node1: ArrayLike, car_rate_area_node2: ArrayLike, car_rate_area_nodes: Any, car_rate_area_struct_pos: ArrayLike, cases: ArrayLike, log_expected: ArrayLike) -> dict:
    """The functions' data inputs, computed from the raw data once per dataset.

    Pass the data by the names the model reads them; a list of arrays is a ragged
    column. Call the other functions with the result: `f(u, **prepared)`.
    """
    area = np.asarray(area, dtype=object)
    car_rate_area_area = np.asarray(car_rate_area_area, dtype=np.int64)
    car_rate_area_comp_size = np.asarray(car_rate_area_comp_size, dtype=np.int64)
    car_rate_area_comp_start = np.asarray(car_rate_area_comp_start, dtype=np.int64)
    car_rate_area_inv_scale = np.asarray(car_rate_area_inv_scale, dtype=np.float64)
    car_rate_area_is_struct = np.asarray(car_rate_area_is_struct, dtype=np.float64)
    car_rate_area_node1 = np.asarray(car_rate_area_node1, dtype=np.int64)
    car_rate_area_node2 = np.asarray(car_rate_area_node2, dtype=np.int64)
    car_rate_area_nodes = np.asarray(car_rate_area_nodes, dtype=object)
    car_rate_area_struct_pos = np.asarray(car_rate_area_struct_pos, dtype=np.int64)
    cases = np.asarray(cases, dtype=np.int64)
    log_expected = np.asarray(log_expected, dtype=np.float64)
    rkppl_index_1 = np.asarray(car_rate_area_comp_start + car_rate_area_comp_size, dtype=np.int64)
    car_rate_area_S = np.sum(car_rate_area_comp_size)
    ppl_axis1_car_rate_area_theta = np.shape(car_rate_area_inv_scale)[0]
    ppl_last_car_rate_area_theta = 3 + ppl_axis1_car_rate_area_theta
    ppl_first_car_rate_area_phi = ppl_last_car_rate_area_theta + 1
    ppl_last_car_rate_area_phi = ppl_first_car_rate_area_phi + (car_rate_area_S - 1)
    car_rate_area_phi_sums_scale = 0.001 * car_rate_area_comp_size
    ppl_yf_cases_resp = np.asarray(cases, dtype=np.float64)
    ppl_lfact_cases_resp = np.sum(ssp.gammaln(ppl_yf_cases_resp + 1.0))
    if len(car_rate_area_node2) == len(car_rate_area_node1):
        value = car_rate_area_node2
    else:

    ppl_prior_car_rate_area_phi_squares = (jnp.zeros(car_rate_area_node1.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in car_rate_area_node1.shape[:1] and ppl_prior_car_rate_area_phi_checked_node2.shape[:1] == car_rate_area_node1.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell_4, in_axes=(0, 0, None))(car_rate_area_node1, ppl_prior_car_rate_area_phi_checked_node2, car_rate_area_phi))
    ppl_prior_car_rate_area_phi_total = jnp.sum(ppl_prior_car_rate_area_phi_squares)
    return_ = -0.5 * ppl_prior_car_rate_area_phi_total
    prior = logpdf + logpdf_2 + logpdf_3 + ppl_factor_car_rate_area_phi_sums + ppl_prior_car_rate_area_theta + return_
    def then_arm_10():
        return None
    def else_arm_10():
        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return None
    value_8 = (then_arm_10() if unconstrained.size == ppl_last_car_rate_area_phi else else_arm_10())
    return prior

    ppl_last_car_rate_area_theta = prepared["ppl_last_car_rate_area_theta"]

    car_rate_area_struct_pos = jnp.asarray(car_rate_area_struct_pos)

    u_argument = unconstrained[1]
    constrain = 1 / (1 + jnp.exp(-u_argument))
    rate_Intercept = unconstrained[2]
    car_rate_area_theta = unconstrained[3:ppl_last_car_rate_area_theta]
    car_rate_area_phi = unconstrained[ppl_first_car_rate_area_phi - 1:ppl_last_car_rate_area_phi]

    car_rate_area_phi_full = car_rate_area_phi_full_gathered[car_rate_area_struct_pos - 1]
    car_rate_area_effects = car_rate_area_sigma * (jnp.sqrt(constrain * car_rate_area_inv_scale) * car_rate_area_phi_full + jnp.sqrt(1.0 - constrain * car_rate_area_is_struct) * car_rate_area_theta)

    ppl_lik_cases_resp = jnp.vdot(_ppl_yf_cases_resp, log_rate) - jnp.sum(jnp.exp(log_rate)) - _ppl_lfact_cases_resp

List each undirected edge once. nodes=all_areas can preserve unobserved areas and islands. An island has an independent effect under BYM2 and zero spatial effect under ICAR. Replay keeps the fitted graph. Read rate directly: the declared log link already maps the predictor onto the count scale.

Smooth surfaces and channels ​

HSGP uses a squared-exponential covariance, smoother than the Matérn field below. iso=true shares a length across axes; iso=false gives each axis its own. by=channel allocates weights per channel, and cor=Omega correlates matching weights between channels.

"""
Each value's position (1-based) in `level_values`: the level codes of a grouping or factor.
"""
ReactiveKernels.@kernel(brm_prepared_indices(values, level_values) = begin
            indices = ReactiveKernels.plate(values) do value
                    Int(findfirst(isequal(value), level_values))
                end
            return indices
        end)

"""
The Hilbert-space basis of an HSGP term at the rows.

Returns `(PHI, omega2)`: `PHI` holds one column per basis function, the Laplacian
eigenfunctions on the term's interval evaluated at each row's axes, and `omega2`
the matching squared frequencies, which the spectral density reads.
"""
ReactiveKernels.@kernel(brm_hsgp_basis_graph(axis_1, axis_2, modes, settings) = begin
            B = prod(modes)
            center_1 = settings[3]
            width_1 = settings[4]
            center_2 = settings[5]
            width_2 = settings[6]
            modes_1 = ReactiveKernels.plate(1:B) do b
                    return div(b - 1, 1) % modes[1] + 1
                end
            frequency_1 = ReactiveKernels.plate(modes_1) do mode
                    return ((mode * pi) / (2width_1)) ^ 2
                end
            modes_2 = ReactiveKernels.plate(1:B) do b
                    return div(b - 1, modes[1]) % modes[2] + 1
                end
            frequency_2 = ReactiveKernels.plate(modes_2) do mode
                    return ((mode * pi) / (2width_2)) ^ 2
                end
            widths = (width_1, width_2)
            centers = (center_1, center_2)
            omega2 = hcat(frequency_1, frequency_2)
            basis_rows = ReactiveKernels.plate(axis_1, axis_2) do x_1, x_2
                    values = ReactiveKernels.plate(1:B) do b
                            return (sin(sqrt(omega2[b, 1]) * ((x_1 - centers[1]) + widths[1])) / sqrt(widths[1])) * (sin(sqrt(omega2[b, 2]) * ((x_2 - centers[2]) + widths[2])) / sqrt(widths[2]))
                        end
                    return values
                end
            PHI = if isempty(basis_rows)
                    zeros(0, B)
                else
                    stack(basis_rows; dims = 1)
                end
            return (PHI, omega2)
        end)

"""
The weight of each HSGP basis function: the square root of the covariance's
spectral density at its frequency, for the marginal scale `sigma` and length
scale `rho`.
"""
ReactiveKernels.@kernel(brm_hsgp_spectral_scales(axis_1, axis_2, modes, settings, sigma, rho) = begin
            (PHI, omega2) = brm_hsgp_basis_graph(axis_1, axis_2, modes, settings)
            weights = ReactiveKernels.plate(axes(omega2, 1)) do b
                    return (sigma * (rho * sqrt(2pi)) ^ (2 / 2)) * exp(-0.25 * (rho ^ 2 * omega2[b, 1] + rho ^ 2 * omega2[b, 2]))
                end
            return weights
        end)

"""
An HSGP term's value at each row: the basis `PHI` times the basis weights `scales`
times the standardized coefficients `z`, each row reading its group's weights.
"""
ReactiveKernels.@kernel(brm_hsgp_spectral_graph(axis_1, axis_2, modes, settings, scales, z, group_index) = begin
            (PHI, omega2) = brm_hsgp_basis_graph(axis_1, axis_2, modes, settings)
            scaled_z = z .* transpose(scales)
            rows = scaled_z[group_index, :]
            value = vec(sum(PHI .* rows; dims = 2))
            return value
        end)

"""
An HSGP term with 2 groups whose length scale and marginal scale may vary by group.

Draws the length scale(s) `rho` and marginal scale(s) `sigma` with their
priors (and their group-level effects, when they have predictors), and the
standardized basis coefficients `z ~ Normal(0, 1)`. Each basis function is weighted
by the square root of the covariance's spectral density (`spectral_scale`); the term at
each row is its basis times the weighted coefficients of its group.
"""
brm_grouped_hsgp(axis_1, axis_2, modes, settings, group_index, L_level) = begin
        rho ~ truncated(LogNormal(log.(25), 0.5), hsgp_east_north_rho_floor, 300)
        sigma ~ Exponential(1)
        z[1:2, 1:prod(modes)] .~ Normal.(0, 1)
        z_level = L_level * z
        spectral_scale = brm_hsgp_spectral_scales(axis_1, axis_2, modes, settings, sigma, rho)
        value = brm_hsgp_spectral_graph(axis_1, axis_2, modes, settings, spectral_scale, z_level, group_index)
        return value
    end

real conditioning_lognormal_lpdf(
    real y,
    real lo,
    int hi,
    real args1,
    real args2
) {
    array[1] real rv;
    rv[1] = negative_infinity();
    if((lo >= hi)) {
        reject("truncated: lower bound must be less than upper bound");
    } else {
        if((y >= lo)) {
            if((y <= hi)) {
                rv[1] = (
                    lognormal_lpdf(y | args1, args2) -
                    log_diff_exp(lognormal_lcdf_stable(hi, args1, args2), lognormal_lcdf_stable(lo, args1, args2))
                );
            }
        }
    }
    return rv[1];
}
real lognormal_lcdf_stable(
    int y,
    real mu,
    real sigma
) {
    return ((y <= 0) ? negative_infinity() : (is_inf(y) ? 0.0 : normal_lcdf_stable(log(y), mu, sigma)));
}
real normal_lcdf_stable(
    real x,

    return (is_inf(x) ? ((x < 0) ? negative_infinity() : 0.0) : ((((x - loc) / scale) < -35) ? std_normal_lcdf_tail(((x - loc) / scale)) : ((((x - loc) / scale) <= 0) ? (log(erfc(((-(x - loc)) / (scale * sqrt(2.0))))) - log(2.0)) : log1m((0.5 * erfc(((x - loc) / (scale * sqrt(2.0)))))))));
}
real std_normal_lcdf_tail(
    real z
) {
    return ((-0.5 * square(z)) + std_normal_scaled_lcdf_tail(z));
}
real std_normal_scaled_lcdf_tail(
    real z
) {
    real w = inv(square(z));
    return (
        ((-log((-z))) - 0.9189385332046728) +
        log1p((w * (-1 + (w * (3 + (w * (-15 + (w * (105 + (w * (-945 + (w * 10395))))))))))))
    );
}
real lognormal_lcdf_stable(
    real y,
    real mu,
    real sigma
) {
    return ((y <= 0) ? negative_infinity() : (is_inf(y) ? 0.0 : normal_lcdf_stable(log(y), mu, sigma)));
}
vector brm_hsgp_sqrt_spd(
    matrix omega2,
    real sigma,
    vector rho

    int d = dims(omega2)[2];
    if (dims(rho)[1] != d) reject("brm_hsgp_sqrt_spd: dim mismatch — `rho` dim 1 (= ", dims(rho)[1], ") does not match `d` (= ", d, "), inferred from `omega2` dim 2. `d` sizes: `omega2` dim 2 (= ", dims(omega2)[2], "), `rho` dim 1 (= ", dims(rho)[1], ").");
    vector[m] rv;

    for(axis in 1:d) {

def log_likelihood(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """The log likelihood of the observations at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`."""

    j = tuple_[1]

            i_4 = tuple__2[0]
            j_3 = tuple__2[1]
            d_4 = tuple__2[2]
            return (None, jnp.asarray(d_4, dtype=jnp.float64), jnp.asarray(i_4, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_3, dtype=jnp.int64), out_3)

    def cell(b, sigma, rho, omega2):
        return_ = sigma * (rho * np.sqrt(2 * np.pi)) ** (2 / 2) * jnp.exp(-0.25 * (rho ** 2 * omega2[b - 1, 0] + rho ** 2 * omega2[b - 1, 1]))
        return return_
    weights = (jnp.zeros(plate_argument.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in plate_argument.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell, in_axes=(0, None, None, None))(plate_argument, constrain, hsgp_east_north_rho, hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_omega2))
    hsgp_east_north_value_scaled_z = hsgp_east_north_z_level * weights
    hsgp_east_north_value_rows = hsgp_east_north_value_scaled_z[hsgp_east_north_group_index - 1, :]
    value_3 = jnp.ravel(jnp.sum(hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_PHI * hsgp_east_north_value_rows, axis=2 - 1, keepdims=True), order="F")
    def cell_2(y_2, mu, sigma):
        def then_arm():
            log_scale = jnp.log(sigma)
            def then_arm_2():
                return 1.0
            def else_arm():
                return sigma
            value_4 = (y_2 - mu) / jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(sigma == 0, y_2 == mu), then_arm_2, else_arm)
            standardized = value_4
            value_5 = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * standardized ** 2
            standard_logpdf = value_5
            def then_arm_3():
                return 0.0
            def else_arm_2():
                return log_scale
            value_6 = standard_logpdf - jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(sigma == 0, y_2 != mu), then_arm_3, else_arm_2)
            return value_6
        def else_arm_3():
            return -jnp.inf
        ppl_density = jax.lax.cond(sigma > 0, then_arm, else_arm_3)
        return ppl_density
    ppl_pw_y_resp = (jnp.zeros(y.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in y.shape[:1] and value_3.shape[:1] == y.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell_2, in_axes=(0, 0, None))(y, value_3, constrain_2))
    ppl_lik_y_resp = jnp.sum(ppl_pw_y_resp)
    def then_arm():
        return None
    def else_arm():
        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return None
    value_4 = (then_arm() if unconstrained.size == _ppl_first_Omega else else_arm())
    return ppl_lik_y_resp


def log_jacobian(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """The log Jacobian of the constraining transforms at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`."""
    hsgp_east_north_rho_floor = prepared["hsgp_east_north_rho_floor"]
    ppl_last_hsgp_east_north_z = prepared["ppl_last_hsgp_east_north_z"]
    ppl_axis2_hsgp_east_north_z = prepared["ppl_axis2_hsgp_east_north_z"]
    _ppl_first_Omega = prepared["_ppl_first_Omega"]
    plate_argument = prepared["plate_argument"]
    hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_omega2 = prepared["hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_omega2"]
    hsgp_east_north_group_index = prepared["hsgp_east_north_group_index"]
    hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_PHI = prepared["hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_PHI"]
    y = prepared["y"]
    ppl_prior_hsgp_east_north_rho_logcdf = prepared["ppl_prior_hsgp_east_north_rho_logcdf"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    plate_argument = jnp.asarray(plate_argument)
    hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_omega2 = jnp.asarray(hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_omega2)
    hsgp_east_north_group_index = jnp.asarray(hsgp_east_north_group_index)
    hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_PHI = jnp.asarray(hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_PHI)
    y = jnp.asarray(y)
    ppl_lkj_raw_Omega = unconstrained[_ppl_first_Omega - 1:_ppl_first_Omega]
    ppl_lkj_partials_Omega = jnp.tanh(ppl_lkj_raw_Omega)
    total = 0.0
    tuple_ = (1, 2)
    i = tuple_[0]
    j = tuple_[1]
    def loop_body(p, carry):
        (i_2, j_2, total_2) = carry
        total_3 = total_2 + (j_2 - i_2 + 1) / 2 * jnp.log(1 - ppl_lkj_partials_Omega[p - 1] ** 2)
        def then_arm():
            return (i_2 + 1, j_2)
        def else_arm():
            return (1, j_2 + 1)
        tuple__2 = jax.lax.cond(i_2 + 1 < j_2, then_arm, else_arm)
        i_3 = tuple__2[0]
        j_3 = tuple__2[1]
        return (i_3, j_3, total_3)
    loop_carry = jax.lax.fori_loop(1, 2, loop_body, (jnp.asarray(i, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(total, dtype=jnp.float64)))
    let_value = loop_carry[2]
    ppl_lkj_logjac_Omega = let_value
    u_argument = unconstrained[1]
    u_argument_2 = unconstrained[2]
    log_jacobian_2 = jnp.log(300.0 - jnp.maximum(hsgp_east_north_rho_floor, 0.0)) - jax.nn.softplus(-unconstrained[0]) - jax.nn.softplus(unconstrained[0]) + u_argument + u_argument_2 + ppl_lkj_logjac_Omega
    def then_arm():
        return None
    def else_arm():
        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return None
    value = (then_arm() if unconstrained.size == _ppl_first_Omega else else_arm())
    return log_jacobian_2


def constrain(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> dict:
    """The constrained value of each parameter, and of each requested value, at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`. Returns a dict, a submodel's values nested under its name:

    - `hsgp_east_north.rho`
    - `hsgp_east_north.sigma`
    - `sigma`
    - `hsgp_east_north.z`
    - `Omega`
    """
    hsgp_east_north_rho_floor = prepared["hsgp_east_north_rho_floor"]
    ppl_last_hsgp_east_north_z = prepared["ppl_last_hsgp_east_north_z"]
    ppl_axis2_hsgp_east_north_z = prepared["ppl_axis2_hsgp_east_north_z"]
    _ppl_first_Omega = prepared["_ppl_first_Omega"]
    plate_argument = prepared["plate_argument"]
    hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_omega2 = prepared["hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_omega2"]
    hsgp_east_north_group_index = prepared["hsgp_east_north_group_index"]
    hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_PHI = prepared["hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_PHI"]
    y = prepared["y"]
    ppl_prior_hsgp_east_north_rho_logcdf = prepared["ppl_prior_hsgp_east_north_rho_logcdf"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    plate_argument = jnp.asarray(plate_argument)
    hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_omega2 = jnp.asarray(hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_omega2)
    hsgp_east_north_group_index = jnp.asarray(hsgp_east_north_group_index)
    hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_PHI = jnp.asarray(hsgp_east_north_spectral_scale_PHI)
    y = jnp.asarray(y)
    ppl_int_hsgp_east_north_rho = unconstrained[0]
    value = _rk_affine_logistic(jnp.maximum(hsgp_east_north_rho_floor, 0.0), 300.0, ppl_int_hsgp_east_north_rho)
    hsgp_east_north_rho = value
    u_argument = unconstrained[1]
    constrain_2 = jnp.exp(u_argument)
    u_argument_2 = unconstrained[2]
    constrain_3 = jnp.exp(u_argument_2)
    ppl_arrflat_hsgp_east_north_z = unconstrained[3:ppl_last_hsgp_east_north_z]
    hsgp_east_north_z = jnp.reshape(ppl_arrflat_hsgp_east_north_z, (2, ppl_axis2_hsgp_east_north_z), order="F")
    ppl_lkj_raw_Omega = unconstrained[_ppl_first_Omega - 1:_ppl_first_Omega]
    ppl_lkj_partials_Omega = jnp.tanh(ppl_lkj_raw_Omega)
    out = jnp.ones((2,), dtype=jnp.float64)
    tuple_ = (1, 2, 1.0)
    i = tuple_[0]
    j = tuple_[1]
    d = tuple_[2]
    def loop_body(p, carry):
        (d_2, i_2, j_2, out_2) = carry
        d_3 = d_2 * jnp.sqrt(1 - ppl_lkj_partials_Omega[p - 1] ** 2)
        def then_arm():
            i_3 = i_2 + 1
            return (None, jnp.asarray(d_3, dtype=jnp.float64), jnp.asarray(i_3, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_2, dtype=jnp.int64), out_2)
        def else_arm():
            out_3 = out_2.at[j_2 - 1].set(d_3)
            tuple__2 = (1, j_2 + 1, 1.0)
            i_4 = tuple__2[0]
            j_3 = tuple__2[1]
            d_4 = tuple__2[2]
            return (None, jnp.asarray(d_4, dtype=jnp.float64), jnp.asarray(i_4, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_3, dtype=jnp.int64), out_3)
        branch = jax.lax.cond(i_2 + 1 < j_2, then_arm, else_arm)
        return (branch[1], branch[2], branch[3], branch[4])
    loop_carry = jax.lax.fori_loop(1, 2, loop_body, (jnp.asarray(d, dtype=jnp.float64), jnp.asarray(i, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j, dtype=jnp.int64), out))
    let_value = loop_carry[3]
    ppl_lkj_diagonal_Omega = let_value
    out_2 = jnp.zeros((2, 2), dtype=jnp.float64)
    out_3 = out_2.at[0, 0].set(1.0)
    tuple__2 = (1, 2, 1.0)
    i_2 = tuple__2[0]
    j_2 = tuple__2[1]
    w = tuple__2[2]
    def loop_body_2(p_2, carry_2):
        (i_3, j_3, out_4, w_2) = carry_2
        out_5 = out_4.at[j_3 - 1, i_3 - 1].set(ppl_lkj_partials_Omega[p_2 - 1] * w_2)
        w_3 = w_2 * jnp.sqrt(1 - ppl_lkj_partials_Omega[p_2 - 1] ** 2)
        def then_arm():
            i_4 = i_3 + 1
            return (None, jnp.asarray(i_4, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_3, dtype=jnp.int64), out_5, jnp.asarray(w_3, dtype=jnp.float64))
        def else_arm():
            out_6 = out_5.at[j_3 - 1, j_3 - 1].set(ppl_lkj_diagonal_Omega[j_3 - 1])
            tuple__3 = (1, j_3 + 1, 1.0)
            i_5 = tuple__3[0]
            j_4 = tuple__3[1]
            w_4 = tuple__3[2]
            return (None, jnp.asarray(i_5, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_4, dtype=jnp.int64), out_6, jnp.asarray(w_4, dtype=jnp.float64))
        branch = jax.lax.cond(i_3 + 1 < j_3, then_arm, else_arm)
        return (branch[1], branch[2], branch[3], branch[4])
    loop_carry_2 = jax.lax.fori_loop(1, 2, loop_body_2, (jnp.asarray(i_2, dtype=jnp.int64), jnp.asarray(j_2, dtype=jnp.int64), out_3, jnp.asarray(w, dtype=jnp.float64)))
    value_2 = loop_carry_2[2]
    Omega = value_2
    def then_arm():
        return None
    def else_arm():
        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return None
    value_3 = (then_arm() if unconstrained.size == _ppl_first_Omega else else_arm())
    return {"hsgp_east_north": {"rho": hsgp_east_north_rho, "sigma": constrain_2, "z": hsgp_east_north_z}, "sigma": constrain_3, "Omega": Omega}


def dimension(prepared: dict) -> int:
    """The length of `unconstrained` for the data `prepared` (what `prepare_data` returned)."""
    return int(prepared["_ppl_first_Omega"])


def parameters(prepared: dict) -> dict:
    """Each parameter's 0-based `start`/`stop` in `unconstrained`, its transform and dimensions,
    for the data `prepared` (what `prepare_data` returned)."""
    return {"hsgp_east_north.rho": {"start": 0, "stop": 1, "transform": "interval", "dims": ()}, "hsgp_east_north.sigma": {"start": 1, "stop": 2, "transform": "exp", "dims": ()}, "sigma": {"start": 2, "stop": 3, "transform": "exp", "dims": ()}, "hsgp_east_north.z": {"start": 3, "stop": int(prepared["ppl_last_hsgp_east_north_z"]), "transform": "identity", "dims": (2, int(prepared["ppl_axis2_hsgp_east_north_z"]))}, "Omega": {"start": int(prepared["_ppl_first_Omega"]) - 1, "stop": int(prepared["_ppl_first_Omega"]), "transform": "lkj", "dims": (2, 2)}}

The lower bound keeps the length inside the fitted basis's approximation range. Increase k when shorter scales matter. For a grid, replay east, north and channel without y, then read the latent mu. Keep the grid inside the fitted domain; replay retains its basis and channel labels.

julia
"""
A Gaussian Markov random field (`gmrf`) over a space-time mesh.

Draws the marginal scale `sigma`, the spatial length `spatial_length` and the
temporal length `temporal_length` from their priors, then the field
`field ~ #brm_callable_(spatial_length, temporal_length, …)` on the mesh `geometry`;
each row reads a weighted sum of three field states (its interpolation weights). Returns `sigma` times those reads, one value per row.
"""
brm_gmrf(geometry, rows, L) = begin
        sigma ~ Exponential(0.7)
        spatial_length ~ LogNormal(log.(0.4), 0.4)
        temporal_length ~ LogNormal(log.(1.7), 0.4)
        field[1:geometry.ncoordinates] ~ brm_value_function(spatial_length, temporal_length, L, geometry)
        return sigma .* .+(rows.weight1 .* field[rows.index1], rows.weight2 .* field[rows.index2], rows.weight3 .* field[rows.index3])
    end

begin
    gmrf_field_east_north_time_channel_support = brm_gmrf_support(xy_fit[1], triangles_fit[1], time_fit, channel_fit)
    gmrf_field_east_north_time_channel_rows = brm_gmrf_rows(gmrf_field_east_north_time_channel_support, east, north, time, channel)
    gmrf_field_east_north_time_channel ~ brm_gmrf(gmrf_field_east_north_time_channel_support.geometry, gmrf_field_east_north_time_channel_rows, Omega)
    field = gmrf_field_east_north_time_channel
    Omega ~ LKJCholesky(2, 2)
    y .~ Normal.(field, 0.2)
end

functions {
real brm_gmrf_lpdf(
    vector field,
    real spatial_length,
    real temporal_length,
    matrix L,
    vector times,
    array[] int permutation,
    vector mass,
    array[] int gptr,
    array[] int grow,
    vector gval,
    array[] int lptr,
    array[] int lrow,
    array[] int previous_ptr,
    array[] int previous_col,
    array[] int previous_pos
) {
    int C = dims(L)[1];
    int N = dims(permutation)[1];
    int NP = dims(gptr)[1];
    int NZ = dims(grow)[1];
    int ND = dims(previous_col)[1];
    if (dims(L)[2] != C) reject("brm_gmrf_lpdf: dim mismatch — `L` dim 2 (= ", dims(L)[2], ") does not match `C` (= ", C, "), inferred from `L` dim 1. `C` sizes: `L` dim 1 (= ", dims(L)[1], "), `L` dim 2 (= ", dims(L)[2], ").");
    if (dims(mass)[1] != N) reject("brm_gmrf_lpdf: dim mismatch — `mass` dim 1 (= ", dims(mass)[1], ") does not match `N` (= ", N, "), inferred from `permutation` dim 1. `N` sizes: `permutation` dim 1 (= ", dims(permutation)[1], "), `mass` dim 1 (= ", dims(mass)[1], ").");
    if (dims(lptr)[1] != NP) reject("brm_gmrf_lpdf: dim mismatch — `lptr` dim 1 (= ", dims(lptr)[1], ") does not match `NP` (= ", NP, "), inferred from `gptr` dim 1. `NP` sizes: `gptr` dim 1 (= ", dims(gptr)[1], "), `lptr` dim 1 (= ", dims(lptr)[1], "), `previous_ptr` dim 1 (= ", dims(previous_ptr)[1], ").");
    if (dims(previous_ptr)[1] != NP) reject("brm_gmrf_lpdf: dim mismatch — `previous_ptr` dim 1 (= ", dims(previous_ptr)[1], ") does not match `NP` (= ", NP, "), inferred from `gptr` dim 1. `NP` sizes: `gptr` dim 1 (= ", dims(gptr)[1], "), `lptr` dim 1 (= ", dims(lptr)[1], "), `previous_ptr` dim 1 (= ", dims(previous_ptr)[1], ").");
    if (dims(gval)[1] != NZ) reject("brm_gmrf_lpdf: dim mismatch — `gval` dim 1 (= ", dims(gval)[1], ") does not match `NZ` (= ", NZ, "), inferred from `grow` dim 1. `NZ` sizes: `grow` dim 1 (= ", dims(grow)[1], "), `gval` dim 1 (= ", dims(gval)[1], ").");
    if (dims(previous_pos)[1] != ND) reject("brm_gmrf_lpdf: dim mismatch — `previous_pos` dim 1 (= ", dims(previous_pos)[1], ") does not match `ND` (= ", ND, "), inferred from `previous_col` dim 1. `ND` sizes: `previous_col` dim 1 (= ", dims(previous_col)[1], "), `previous_pos` dim 1 (= ", dims(previous_pos)[1], ").");
    return brm_gmrf_logdensity(
        field,
        spatial_length,
        temporal_length,
        L,
        times,
        permutation,
        mass,
        gptr,
        grow,
        gval,
        lptr,
        lrow,
        previous_ptr,
        previous_col,
        previous_pos
    );
}
real brm_gmrf_logdensity(
    vector field,
    real spatial_length,
    real temporal_length,
    matrix L,
    vector times,
    array[] int permutation,
    vector mass,
    array[] int gptr,
    array[] int grow,
    vector gval,
    array[] int lptr,
    array[] int lrow,
    array[] int previous_ptr,
    array[] int previous_col,
    array[] int previous_pos
) {
    int D = dims(field)[1];
    int C = dims(L)[1];
    int T = dims(times)[1];
    int N = dims(permutation)[1];
    int NP = dims(gptr)[1];
    int NZ = dims(grow)[1];
    int ND = dims(previous_col)[1];
    if (dims(L)[2] != C) reject("brm_gmrf_logdensity: dim mismatch — `L` dim 2 (= ", dims(L)[2], ") does not match `C` (= ", C, "), inferred from `L` dim 1. `C` sizes: `L` dim 1 (= ", dims(L)[1], "), `L` dim 2 (= ", dims(L)[2], ").");

}

The term directly contributes the field, without an extra population coefficient. Omit channel for a single field; omit cor for independent channels. cor may also name a known correlation matrix. Replace a supported term prior by = value to fix that quantity.

QuantityInterpretationUnits
sdNominal continuum marginal SDPredictor units
Spatial length_scaleMatérn ν=1 length ell_s; practical range is 2ell_sCoordinate units
Temporal length_scaleOU correlation time ell_t; a gap of ell_t has correlation exp(-1)Time units

All three default to LogNormal(0,1). Finite-mesh marginal variances depend on boundary and resolution, so its SD is a continuum parameter, not a promise of identical vertex variances. The normalized field density includes the hyperparameter-dependent determinants.

Representation and prediction ​

RepresentationState and replay boundary
MeshVertices × fitted times × channels; three barycentric reads per observation. New coordinates may lie inside the mesh, but frozen replay requires fitted times and channels.
neighbors=mLocal conditionals on distinct observed position–time states. Spatial and temporal covariance are approximated. Frozen replay keeps that support.
multiresolution=mSparse normalized spatial basis with exact OU temporal covariance and marginal SD. Basis paths use their readers' time unions; frozen replay keeps positions and times.

For neighbors, brm_gmrf_predict can evaluate new points. Without an RNG it returns conditional means; pass an RNG to include conditional new-point variation. These draws have pointwise conditional laws and do not supply the joint covariance needed for uncertainty in spatial totals. Observation noise is added only when predicting measurements.

The figure isolates the OU temporal factor at one location and channel, computed directly as exp(-gap / ell_t). It shows how a fixed prior correlation time changes dependence; it is not a posterior reconstruction.

All representations support full-model MCMC on RK and Stan. RK mesh fields may live in independent plate cells; the cell predictor must be 0 + gmrf, and shared channel correlation belongs outside the cell. Neighbor fields do not use that plate or embedded-Laplace surface. field_states=:units lets supported field states become SVI units; see the SVI example. Embedded Laplace is an explicit mesh integration choice. Large operator solves use a fixed-probe determinant estimate, so even a Gaussian integral can be approximate. Check the solver and probe settings against the accuracy needed for the fit. The representation notes retain the precision derivations and synthetic benchmark protocols.

Continue to the spatial-fields example for a fitted station field with its diagnostics and maps. For a continuous-time latent process fitted to discrete observations, continue to the state-space example.
